rationale: Both factor (3x - 2) out of the first two terms, simplify to 3x - 1, and evaluate to 11. The crux of the problem is how to read the ambiguous-looking '-(3x-2)4x+1'. A makes the reading explicit, rewriting it as -((3x-2)(4x)) + 1 before factoring, so the trailing +1 is clearly outside the product. B factors straight away without stating that reading. A's reasoning is therefore more transparent at the one step where a reader could go wrong.
